summary: Frontend-only smoke + critical-flow test of CVF Sports MVP. Verified the PRIMARY 8-step success test (admin enters score on upcoming kickball game g4 -> result propagates to game detail, schedule, standings, both team pages, player profile (public + private), and leaderboards). All shared-state propagation works correctly. Also validated role-gated access, captain free-agent invite, team registration, and free agent signup flows.
critical_code_review_comments: RoleContext and AppStateContext both use in-memory useState with no persistence (localStorage/sessionStorage). A browser reload or hard navigation wipes the demo state, including any score the admin just entered. For a demo this is acceptable, but it makes the app feel buggy if a user refreshes mid-demo. Consider adding lightweight localStorage persistence for both contexts so demo data survives reloads.

ScoreEntry useEffect dependency array is `[gameId]` only with eslint-disable - if the underlying `game` object's stat rows change while the user is editing the same game, the form won't re-prefill. Minor.

Admin Free Agents tab uses a different data-testid than the convention `admin-tab-freeagents` (this testid doesn't exist). The 'FREE AGENTS' tab is present and visually works, but tests that try `admin-tab-freeagents` will fail. Recommend standardizing on `admin-tab-free-agents` or `admin-tab-freeagents` and aligning across the codebase.

GameDetail page does not appear to render a visible 'Final' word/badge in the main content area when status=completed (the inning table + Edit Score button is shown for admin). Schedule card and toast correctly show Final. Consider adding a 'FINAL' badge on the game detail header for consistency with the schedule card.
test_credentials: None - no auth in app. Role switcher (data-testid=role-switcher) used to swap demo roles.
seed_data_creation: Created in-memory only during test runs: TEST Squad team registration, TEST FreeAgent free agent signup, and submitted a score for game g4 (Sandia Sluggers 6 @ Rio Grande Rollers 3 with stats for player p1 Marcus Trujillo: 2 HR, 4 RBI, 3 R). None persisted (state is in-memory by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: AppStateContext and RoleContext are in-memory only. ANY page.goto() (full navigation) resets the entire app state including role and submitted scores. To test shared-state propagation across pages, you MUST use SPA navigation (history.pushState + popstate event) rather than page.goto(). See iteration_1 script for the goto_spa() helper pattern. Game g4 baseline: home t2 Rio Grande Rollers, away t1 Sandia Sluggers, upcoming kickball; before score entry t1=2-0 t2=0-2; after submitting away wins 6-3 t1=3-0 t2=0-3.
